verdict.rationale: GitBook's GitHub/GitLab Sync puts docs content into a user-owned Git repo, and the editor is Markdown-based, so page content can leave in an open format. A RESTful API also offers programmatic access. However, no evidence describes a full-account export covering all data, or a documented exit or migration-away path. Missing for 10: an explicit all-data export feature (including analytics, AI insights, change requests and site configuration), documentation that Git Sync output is complete open-format Markdown, and independent hands-on confirmation of leaving GitBook cleanly.
